items.title: Create a runtime artifact registry
items.context: Define runtime/log/cache artifact paths and gitignore patterns in a single core registry instead of scattered string checks.

items.title: Wire freshness and dirty-risk checks to the registry
items.context: currentMaterialHash and changed-file freshness must exclude runtime artifacts; baseline risk and DONE-related hints should classify tracked runtime logs as repairable runtime artifacts.

items.title: Make init and doctor repair runtime artifact drift
items.context: koala init should merge required ignore patterns into existing .gitignore; doctor should detect tracked runtime artifacts and provide repair guidance or repair path.

items.title: Add hard-coded regression coverage
items.context: Update freshness smoke and add contract coverage so .koala/activity.jsonl is runtime metadata, not material, and required ignore patterns cannot drift.
